definition: An AI system trained on huge amounts of text to predict and write language. Chat assistants are built on them.
A small piece of text, often part of a word, that models read and write. Usage is priced per token; one English token is about four characters.
How much text a model can consider at once, counted in tokens. It includes your instructions, documents, and the reply.
The internal numbers a model learns in training. More parameters often means more capability and higher running costs, not always better answers.
Extra training on a smaller, focused set of examples so a model gets better at one style or task.
Running a trained model to get an answer. Inference is what you pay for each time a model responds.
A model whose trained parameters are published, so anyone can download and run it, subject to its license.
A standard test for comparing models. Scores help, but they rarely match the exact task you care about.
A ranked list of models by test score. Check what the test measures before trusting the order.
When a model states something false with confidence. Check important claims against the original source.
Able to work with more than one kind of input or output, such as text, images, audio, or video.
An AI system that takes several steps on its own, such as searching or using tools, to finish a task you set.
A model that works through a problem in steps before answering. Often better at math and logic, but slower and pricier.
A way for software to talk to a service. Developers use a model’s API to send prompts from their own apps.
A secret code that lets an app use a service on your account. Treat it like a password.
A model first looks up relevant documents, then answers using them. It helps keep answers tied to specific sources.
The material a model learned from. It shapes what the model knows and where its blind spots are.
A building full of computers. AI data centers need large amounts of power, water, and cooling.
A chip that does many calculations at once. AI models are trained and run on huge numbers of them.
